summary: Verified email deliverability fixes (emailer.py) via monkeypatched pytest and per-section home copy via Playwright. 7/7 backend unit tests pass; all 8 required home-page substrings present with distinct subtexts across 6 sections; tracking form navigation and 0 console/page errors on home.
action_items: Reminder (already known): SENDER_EMAIL is still onboarding@resend.dev in backend/.env — DNS/domain verification is a user action; the warning log is emitted correctly. Deliverability will only fully recover once a verified sender domain is configured.
critical_code_review_comments: emailer.send_email: reply_to falls back to ADMIN_EMAIL correctly. Consider also adding reply_to when RESEND_API_KEY is a placeholder (currently only computed inside the send branch — informational only, not a bug since no send happens).
_html_to_text handles  /&/</> and script/style tags; other entities (e.g. ö, ') are not decoded. Turkish templates don't use them today, but html.unescape would be a safer generic fix.

MARKETING_KINDS currently includes {'draft_reminder','draft_saved'}. Confirm List-Unsubscribe on 'draft_saved' is intentional — draft_saved is arguably transactional (user just saved their own form), and adding List-Unsubscribe there is unusual.
